i. The Vehicles are required for traveling in Surface area including surface areas of n eighboring places / states. ii. The vehicles should be Bolero/Scorpio/Sumo (with AC). Registration year of t he vehicles should not be earlier than January, 2025. At least one of the vehic les must be in the name of the Contractor, for the rest vehicles the Contractor sho uld have the power of attorney. The vehicle must be in good condition in all respec ts. iii. The vehicles will be on duty for 12 hours every day (normal working hours) from 8.00 AM to 8.00 PM on all seven days a week. Company will not provide any time f or filling of diesel / petrol and for maintenance during duty hours. However, for mai ntenance of the vehicles will be allowed for four hours in a week by authorized official of HCL/MCP. If the vehicle is used beyond 12 hours both in camp & outstatio n an amount of Rs. 25.00 per hour will be paid for extra hours as OT. If the vehicle is sent out of station more than 100 kms one way in a day a DA of Rs. 200.00 (Rup ees One hundred and fifty) per trip will be paid for the driver. Toll Tax and parking (subject to submission of receipt) will be reimbursed. 21.1 GENERAL TERMS & CONDITIONS 1. The drivers should be vocationally trained under MVTR and must possess valid license. Driver should be free from alcohol while on duty, must have good behavior with officials. In case any shortcomings are foun d in this regard the driver should be replaced with a good one. 2. The contractor should comply with all Government/ RTO Rules and Regulations throughout the deploym ent of the vehicle. The contractor should also comply with all the provisions of Motor Vehicle Act as applica ble. 3. Liabilities arising out of traffic rules violation, accident or negligence of the driver, if any, will be on contr actor's account. HCL/MCP will not be responsible for cases of any nature whatsoever in this regard. 4. It will be contractor's responsibility to maintain log-book, duty-wise signature duly signed by the concer ned official. 5. All valid documents relating to Registration, Insurance, Permit, Fitness, PUC and Driving License in origi nal should always be available with the vehicle so that the same can be produced as and when demanded on road by concerned authority. 6. It will be the responsibility of the contractor to keep the vehicles in good road-worthy condition. 7. In case of the vehicles becoming off road, alternate vehicles should be provided by the contractor for th at period without any loss of time so that work does not suffer. The amount of the breakdown hours of vehi cles will be recovered on pro-rata basis from the bill subject to maximum of 5% of the running bills, if the al ternate vehicle is not provided by the contractor within one hour. 8. The contract will be for a period of 36 months. If required HCL/MCP may extend the contract for anoth er 9 months on the same terms and conditions. 9. Cost of fuel will be reimbursed once in a month. Any increase/decrease in the cost of fuel shall be reimb ursed/adjusted on production of proof, and the same shall be payable from the date of change in Diesel pri ce. Documentary proof of fuel rate should be submitted by the party along with the bills every month. 21.2 SPECIAL TERMS & CONDITIONS 1. Valid Taxi/Commercial Permit, as applicable. 2. High Security Registration Plate (HSRP), as prescribed under Government regulations. 3. Valid Registration Certificate (RC). 4. Valid Fitness Certificate.

5. Comprehensive lnsurance. 6. Valid Pollution Under Control (PUC) Certificate. 7. Payment of applicable Road Tax and other statutory levies. 8. Valid Driving Licence of the driver and compliance with all other statutory requirements app licable to hired/commercial vehicles 22.2 SUBMISSION OF BILL & PAYMENT TERM The contractor shall submit monthly R.A. Bills after completion of each month to the Engineer-in-Charge. Engineer-in-Charge shall check & certify the bills and then forwa rd the same to Finance Department for release of payments. However, 100% eligible payment after deduction, if any, will be made within 30 days through E-Payment afte r receiving of the bills by engineer in charge in triplicate with all necessary document s. Payment shall be made as per the Mandate Form submitted along with the bid as per Annexure II. 27.
